note: The layout norms of every film: where what a viewer reads may stand and how large it is. One source: core/design.py reads it for the worker, skills/build-plan/scripts/norms.json is its copy inside a project, Pure Kinetic's plan.js (SAFE, TYPE, typeOf) holds the same numbers, and tests/test_design.py keeps the three equal. The numbers are Pure Kinetic's (HISTORY 332, 335, 337).

parts.label: a number, a tag, a note
parts.body: a line under a title, a button
parts.lead: an item of a list, the main line
parts.title: a scene's title
parts.big: a figure, a word that carries the scene
